pm_exper_user_324_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some good smartphone apps that can keep me informed about important events and changes happening during the day?
pm_exper_user_324_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) For staying up to date during the day, you might like apps like AccuWeather or CARROT Weather for precise forecasts, plus Google News or Flipboard for broader event updates. You can even set personalized alerts so you’ll know immediately if there’s a sudden weather shift or a breaking local headline — handy for keeping your plans (and cycling routes!) adaptable.
(b) For staying up to date during the day, you might like apps like Google News or Apple News for headlines, plus Twitter/X or Reddit for real-time updates. You can even set personalized alerts so you'll know immediately when an important news story breaks or when there are changes relevant to your interests.
(c) For staying up to date during the day, you might like apps like Behance or Dribbble for creative inspiration, plus Pinterest for visual idea boards. You can even set personalized alerts so you'll know immediately when new design trends or UI inspiration posts go live — great for sparking ideas during prototyping sessions.
(d) For staying up to date during the day, you might like apps like Spotify for discovering new music, plus Pocket Casts or Overcast for podcast updates. You can even set personalized notifications so you'll know immediately when a favorite artist drops a track or a new episode releases — perfect for keeping your listening queue fresh while working.
